# VS Code Setup

This document describes the VS Code configuration files auto-generated by the project scaffold scripts.

## Generated Files

Both `/ufil:init-project --modular` (Claude) / `$ufil:init-project --modular` (Codex) and `/ufil:init-project --single` / `$ufil:init-project --single` automatically create:

```
.vscode/
├── launch.json     # Run/debug configurations per flavor
└── settings.json   # Editor, Dart, and file settings
```

---

## launch.json

### Modular Project

Modular projects have 3 flavors (dev, staging, prod) with debug and release modes:

```json
{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "configurations": [
    {
      "name": "dev",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "app/lib/main_dev.dart",
      "args": ["--flavor", "dev"]
    },
    {
      "name": "staging",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "app/lib/main_staging.dart",
      "args": ["--flavor", "staging"]
    },
    {
      "name": "prod",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "app/lib/main_prod.dart",
      "args": ["--flavor", "prod"]
    },
    {
      "name": "dev (release)",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "app/lib/main_dev.dart",
      "args": ["--flavor", "dev", "--release"]
    },
    {
      "name": "staging (release)",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "app/lib/main_staging.dart",
      "args": ["--flavor", "staging", "--release"]
    },
    {
      "name": "prod (release)",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "app/lib/main_prod.dart",
      "args": ["--flavor", "prod", "--release"]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Single-Module Project

Single-module projects have a single entry point with debug, release, and profile modes:

```json
{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "configurations": [
    {
      "name": "debug",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "lib/main.dart"
    },
    {
      "name": "release",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "lib/main.dart",
      "args": ["--release"]
    },
    {
      "name": "profile",
      "request": "launch",
      "type": "dart",
      "program": "lib/main.dart",
      "args": ["--profile"]
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## settings.json

Settings are the same for both project types. The `dart.flutterSdkPath` is auto-detected from FVM at project creation time.

### Dart Settings

| Setting                                     | Value                     | Description                    |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `dart.flutterSdkPath`                       | `.fvm/versions/<version>` | Use FVM-managed Flutter SDK    |
| `dart.lineLength`                           | `80`                      | Max line length                |
| `dart.flutterHotReloadOnSave`               | `never`                   | Disable auto hot reload        |
| `dart.previewFlutterUiGuides`               | `true`                    | Show widget tree guides        |
| `dart.previewFlutterUiGuidesCustomTracking` | `true`                    | Enhanced widget tracking       |
| `dart.debugExternalPackageLibraries`        | `false`                   | Skip external libs in debugger |
| `dart.debugSdkLibraries`                    | `false`                   | Skip SDK libs in debugger      |

### Editor Settings

| Setting                                  | Value       | Description                          |
| ---------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `editor.formatOnSave`                    | `true`      | Auto format on save (Dart only)      |
| `editor.formatOnType`                    | `true`      | Auto format while typing (Dart only) |
| `source.fixAll`                          | `always`    | Auto fix lint issues on save         |
| `source.organizeImports`                 | `always`    | Auto organize imports on save        |
| `editor.tabSize`                         | `2`         | 2-space indentation                  |
| `editor.rulers`                          | `[80, 120]` | Visual rulers at 80 and 120 chars    |
| `editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled` | `true`      | Color matching brackets              |

### File Settings

| Setting                        | Value        | Description                    |
| ------------------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------ |
| `files.autoSave`               | `afterDelay` | Auto save files                |
| `files.autoSaveDelay`          | `0`          | Save immediately               |
| `files.trimTrailingWhitespace` | `true`       | Remove trailing spaces         |
| `files.insertFinalNewline`     | `true`       | Ensure files end with newline  |
| `files.trimFinalNewlines`      | `true`       | Remove extra trailing newlines |

### File Nesting

Generated files are nested under their source files in the explorer:

```
user_model.dart
  ├── user_model.freezed.dart
  └── user_model.g.dart

feature_auth_route.dart
  └── feature_auth_route.gr.dart

di.dart
  └── di.config.dart
```

### Search Exclude

Generated files are excluded from search to reduce noise:

- `*.g.dart` — JSON serializable
- `*.freezed.dart` — Freezed
- `*.gr.dart` — Auto Route
- `*.config.dart` — Injectable
- `lib/gen/**` — flutter_gen assets
- `.fvm` — FVM cache
- `build` — Build output
- `.dart_tool` — Dart tool cache

### Watcher Exclude

Heavy directories are excluded from file watching for performance:

- `.git/objects/**`
- `.git/subtree-cache/**`
- `build/**`
- `.dart_tool/**`

## Updating Flutter SDK Path

When upgrading Flutter via FVM, update `dart.flutterSdkPath` in `settings.json`:

```bash
# Install new version
fvm install 3.42.0
fvm use 3.42.0

# Update settings.json
# Change: "dart.flutterSdkPath": ".fvm/versions/3.42.0"
```

Or use the symlink approach (no manual update needed):

```json
{
  "dart.flutterSdkPath": ".fvm/flutter_sdk"
}
```

> Note: The symlink approach (`.fvm/flutter_sdk`) works but some IDE features may not resolve it correctly. Using the explicit version path is more reliable.
